set.body:
Requested by a downstream desktop host (eyes4s Studio), stated generically. Found while building a canvas host on the 56506d2 interaction pieces.

Problem
The JavaFX interaction host draws focus and selection outlines with hard-coded colours, and outlines are axis-aligned rectangles regardless of mark shape. Hosts with their own design tokens (accent, contrast, dark mode) and round or diamond marks cannot match their visual language or WCAG focus-indicator requirements.

Scope
Make overlay styling a value (colours, widths, casing, halo) supplied by the host, and draw outlines that follow the mark's geometry (circle, diamond, path) with a configurable offset.

Acceptance criteria
1. Overlay colours, stroke widths and casing come from a host-provided style value; defaults unchanged.
2. Focus and selection outlines for circle/diamond/path marks follow the shape at a configurable offset, at 1x and 2x.
3. A focus indicator meeting 3:1 contrast against both light and dark backgrounds is expressible.
set.title: [Intaglio] Themeable interaction overlay: focus and selection styling follow mark geometry
